subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should arbitrary JSONL message logs become a supported builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` source, or should raw-log ingestion remain plugin-owned outside the builtin memory index?
rationale: The answer determines whether OpenClaw expands a sensitive builtin data-ingestion contract or relies on the plugin-first memory extension path; source-level parsing alone cannot safely choose the privacy and ownership model.

options.title: Keep raw-log ingestion plugin-owned
options.body: Publish or document a converter or memory plugin that selects, redacts, and indexes raw logs without broadening builtin extra-path semantics.

options.title: Define a builtin JSONL contract
options.body: Specify supported record shapes, redaction and scope rules, line mapping, watcher behavior, and `memory_get` policy before implementing coordinated support.

recommendation.title: Keep raw-log ingestion plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Publish or document a converter or memory plugin that selects, redacts, and indexes raw logs without broadening builtin extra-path semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review and memory-path history connect this contributor to the relevant builtin memory and session-ingestion boundary.
